CustomField.label: Header Style
CustomField.description: How a section draws its header when Header Display is Header. Classic is the standard header; Outlined draws a border round the whole section with the title on the top line. Blank is treated as Classic.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: How the header sits in the section frame. Title on border (stored as outlined) needs a Box or Shadow frame. See Section Frame and Header in the docs.
